user.title: New room light
user.description: Night light after sunset, optional auto light when it is dark, and the remembered normal state for manual use.

data_description.light: The light (or group) that is watched and switched off.
data_description.lights: Lights that are switched on and whose normal state is remembered. Empty = members of the group.
data_description.occupancy_sensors: The room counts as occupied while any of them is on.
data_description.night_brightness: After sunset. Decimals allowed (0.8 % = smallest visible level of many lamps).
data_description.illuminance_sensor: Enables the auto light: during the day, motion switches the light on when it is dark.
data_description.quiet_entity: While on, motion does not switch the light on.
data_description.button_ieee: e.g. 00:17:88:01:0e:d5:1f:ec – the button toggles night light / normal / off.
data_description.button_command: ZHA command of the button, e.g. off_press.

error.no_occupancy: Select at least one motion or presence sensor.

abort.already_configured: This light is already set up.
